differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 41.5 fL) with low RBC count and high platelet distribution width suggests iron loss, common in older adults (GI bleed, poor nutrition) and consistent with loss of teeth and stress.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Co‑existing hypertension, obesity, prediabetes and chronic inflammation (e.g., viral sinusitis) can cause normocytic‑to‑microcytic anemia via hepcidin‑mediated iron sequestration.

differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Marked microcytosis with relatively normal hemoglobin and hematocrit; often discovered incidentally in adults without overt iron deficiency.

differential.name: Sideroblastic anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia with normal iron studies can be drug‑induced or hereditary; fits the abnormal platelet indices and lack of overt iron deficiency.

differential.name: Anemia secondary to chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Hypertension and obesity increase CKD risk; although creatinine is normal, early CKD can cause mild anemia via reduced erythropoietin.
